concept.title: How Aria Mesh Networking Works
concept.shortdesc: Aria uses a mesh network where multiple nodes work together to provide whole-home Wi-Fi coverage.

conbody.p: Unlike a traditional router that covers a single area, a mesh network consists of a main node connected to your modem and one or more satellite nodes placed around your home. Each node communicates with the others to create a single, seamless network.

Devices automatically connect to whichever node provides the strongest signal. If a node goes offline or loses connection to the mesh, devices in its area will lose network access until the node is restored.
The Aria app shows the status of each node in real time. A green icon means the node is healthy. A yellow icon means it is connected but experiencing interference. A red icon means it is offline.
